title: Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban
content: Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.

title: Trump and Xi meet at moment of global consequence
content: It is the second time the leaders are meeting this year after the Beijing summit in May.

title: Iran's president gives a rare wartime speech at the U.N.
content: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the U.N. General Assembly a day after President Trump threatened from the same podium to "annihilate" Iran.

title: A Catholic media star will be beatified in St. Louis, moving a step closer to sainthood
content: Bishop Fulton Sheen, who charmed millions of television viewers on his show Life Is Worth Living,'will come one step closer to being declared a saint.

title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
content: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.

title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
content: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
content: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
content: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.

title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
content: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."

title: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
content: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.
